metadata.document_title: Heron Payments Mobile API Security Assessment

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_title: Broken object level authorisation on statements
vulnerabilities.description: Changing the account number in the statements path returned statements belonging to other customers for any logged-in user.
vulnerabilities.business_impact: Disclosure of financial records of all customers.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Check that the authenticated customer owns the requested account on every statements request.

vulnerabilities.description: Tokens signed with alg=none were accepted by the gateway.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Pin the accepted signing algorithm and reject unsigned tokens.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_title: Excessive data exposure in profile API
vulnerabilities.description: The profile response included the customer's full PAN and internal risk score although the app displays neither.
vulnerabilities.business_impact: Sensitive data exposed to any client able to read the response.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Return only the fields the client needs and mask card numbers server-side.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_title: Broken access control on token API
vulnerabilities.description: Device tokens could be revoked by any authenticated user for any other user's device.
vulnerabilities.business_impact: Targeted denial of service against customers.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce ownership checks on token revocation.

conclusion: One critical authorisation flaw requires immediate remediation.
